data.name: Ruhail
data.gender_notes: Ruhail is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ruhail is an Arabic name that means traveler, explorer. It is derived from the word 'ruh' which means spirit, and 'hal' which means travel, journey. This name is associated with adventure and exploration, but also with spirituality and inner journeys. The name Ruhail carries the meaning “Traveler, Explorer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Ruhail usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler, explorer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your life be filled with meaningful journeys and spiritual explorations.
data.etymology: Ruhail belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler, Explorer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruhail total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Ruhail
in_english.long_meaning: Ruhail is an Arabic name that means a person with good character and a kind heart, it signifies comfort, peace, and tranquility, derived from the Arabic root 'r-w-h' which relates to the concept of rest and relaxation

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruhail reflects the nomadic heritage of many early Islamic communities who were travelers and explorers by nature, constantly seeking new lands, resources, and knowledge. It also embodies the spirit of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who, in his night journey (Isra' and Mi'raj), traveled to the farthest corners of the world. As a result, the name Ruhail remains relevant for Muslims today, inspiring us to explore new horizons, to seek knowledge, and to broaden our perspectives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ruhail also holds deep spiritual significance as it relates to the idea of the spiritual journey or "safar" in Islamic tradition. It reminds us that our true purpose in life is to journey inward, to seek knowledge of God and to strive towards spiritual perfection. The name Ruhail is a reminder that our ultimate goal is not to accumulate material possessions or to seek temporary pleasures, but to embark on a lifelong spiritual journey towards God. Thus, the name Ruhail is not only associated with physical journeys and exploration, but also with the internal journey towards self-improvement and closeness to Allah SWT.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Ruhail is derived from the Arabic word "Ruh" meaning spirit. This name signifies a person with a strong and enlightened spirit, deeply connected to the Divine and guided by inner wisdom. Ruhail is one who embodies the essence of spiritual awareness, transcending worldly distractions and seeking the path of truth and inner peace.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ruhail is mentioned in the book 'The History of Islamic Names' by Muhammad al-Hassan The name Ruhail carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Ruhail was popularized during the Islamic Golden Age
